title: 1Password says an attacker used an employee's GitHub account to push malicious code to its backend, taking some users' names and emails; vaults weren't accessed (Zack Whittaker/TechCrunch)
summary: Zack Whittaker / TechCrunch: 1Password says an attacker used an employee's GitHub account to push malicious code to its backend, taking some users' names and emails; vaults weren't accessed — Password manager maker 1Password has confirmed that some customer information was taken in a recent intrusion into its internal systems …
